reasons.claim: 4.52 ha regeneration felling notification in Kungsbacka, status notified; no completed felling overlap (0%).

One eligible species within 250 m: Goodyera repens (VU vascular plant, site-bound, forest-associated; threats include lack of dead wood and increased openness). It has 4 records, the nearest 40 m from the polygon edge (2026, 5 m uncertainty), all from 2026 with 5 m uncertainty.
Effort is adequate (115 records within 1000 m, 68th percentile, county median 98). Near the site there are 43 records on 10 days within 250 m and none inside the polygon.
Poecile montanus (NT, mobile forest bird) was recorded 99 m away in 2024. It is only supporting evidence.

uncertainties: Records show the species was recorded just outside the polygon, not that it occupies the felling area itself; no record falls inside the polygon.
The records are close to the edge, so whether the plants lie in the stand to be felled needs field confirmation.
The number of Goodyera repens individuals and their exact extent are unknown.
not_established: Whether Goodyera repens occurs inside the felling polygon.
Forest age or structure of the stand.
Legality of the felling or any measure of biodiversity.
next_action: Reviewer should prioritise a field check of the Goodyera repens locations 40–169 m from the polygon, and of the polygon edge, for dead wood and the plant itself before felling can start.
